verdicts.reason: A breaks up the centred stack for no clear reason. The logo is pushed to the left, the sale banner to the right, and the bottle sits off-centre with a large empty area to its right. The subcopy and the legal text sit on either side of the CTA, and the legal text is squeezed into a tiny, narrow, ragged column that is hard to read. B keeps the original centred layout, brand and hierarchy intact, but the bottom block is cramped: the headline, subcopy, CTA and legal text have almost no space between them, the legal line sits close to the bottom edge, and the sale banner has shrunk so it competes less.
